_comment: Which model, from where, under what licence, and WHICH REVISION.
docs/model-licences.md is the prose audit; this is the machine-readable
companion that the preflight and the benchmark read, so a report can say
Every `revision` is null. That is deliberate and is not an oversight: no
model has been downloaded, so no revision has been observed, and writing a
plausible commit SHA here would be inventing evidence. On the first
download, record the resolved revision with:
which reads the revision Hugging Face resolved and writes it back here.
Until then every report says `revision: null, pinned: false`, and nothing
may describe a run as reproducible.
`gated` means the publisher requires an agreement accepted interactively
under the downloading account. An unattended download of a gated repo
fails. Do not accept an agreement on someone else's behalf.
`licence_resolved` false means the licence is NOT settled for commercial
use, whatever the repo declares. See the referenced question in

models.name: vision
models.notes: The 7B is Apache-2.0. Larger Qwen-VL variants have used a custom licence; do not substitute one without re-checking.

models.name: speech-description-tokenizer
models.notes: Tokenizer files only; Indic Parler-TTS conditions on a flan-t5 description encoder. Licence verified 20 October 2026: apache-2.0, ungated. The card advises a safety and fairness assessment before using the model directly -- a usage guideline, not a licence term, and Lumina uses only its tokenizer, so no text is generated by it.

models.name: listen-back-asr
models.notes: Transcribes each narration take for the listen-back check. Needs a .lumina-complete sentinel in its directory or the check silently disables. Licence verified 20 October 2026 on the model card: MIT, ungated, no access agreement. It was recorded here as apache-2.0 on first writing, which was wrong.

models.name: translation
models.notes: GATED: a contact-sharing agreement must be accepted once, interactively, under the account that downloads it. An unattended download fails. See Q3.

models.name: image-unet
models.notes: Repackaged; upstream Tongyi-MAI/Z-Image-Turbo is also apache-2.0.

models.name: image-text-encoder
models.notes: A distinct file from the planner model, despite the name.

models.name: image-vae
models.notes: UNRESOLVED. Comfy-Org declares apache-2.0; community sources describe it as the FLUX.1 autoencoder, and the two FLUX.1 lines differ (schnell apache-2.0, dev not). Fine for a benchmark, unresolved for commercial use. See Q1.

models.name: motion-unet
models.notes: Upstream Wan-AI/Wan2.2-TI2V-5B states apache-2.0 in a Licence Agreement section.

models.name: motion-vae
models.notes: Wan-trained, covered by the Wan licence agreement.
